name: Find the Alien VR: Impostor Hunt
summary:
Become Earth's last line of defense in Find the Alien VR!
Step into a fully immersive virtual reality experience where nothing is what it seems. Use advanced alien-detection tech to scan suspicious beings, uncover impostors, and neutralize threats before it’s too late.

🧬 Game Features:

🔎 Alien Scanner – Use your VR scanner to detect disguised aliens in real-time

🎯 Action Shooter Gameplay – Eliminate hostile invaders in smooth, intuitive VR combat

🧠 Memory & Reflex Challenges – Don’t trust your eyes;
